description: This file defines an HTTPService interface and its implementation for making HTTP requests with custom transport settings, including security and configuration handling, specific to the Mattermost project.

classes.name: HTTPServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the HTTPService interface, managing configuration and request timeout.

classes.name: pluginAPIConfigServiceAdapter
classes.description: Adapter to allow plugin API to provide configuration to the HTTPService.

methods.name: splitFields
methods.description: Utility function to split fields based on whitespace or comma.

methods.name: MakeHTTPService
methods.description: Factory function to create an HTTPService with a given configuration service.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Method to retrieve configuration from pluginAPIConfigServiceAdapter.

methods.name: MakeHTTPServicePlugin
methods.description: Factory function to create an HTTPService using a plugin API.

methods.description: Creates an HTTP client with custom transport and timeout.

methods.name: MakeTransport
